instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Get the instruction my AI writes a research profile of a company or a prospect from: fit against my criteria, the biggest problems the material shows, why now, a case study to cite, ways to reach them", and give it key (One short name for the prospect, with no /); criteria (What makes a good prospect for you).
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:brief-a-prospect and its input (the worked example shows one).

3. Read what comes back: Give key (one short name for the prospect, such as its website address, the same in every later action), criteria (what makes a good prospect for you), and the gathered material: material (one text) or evidence ([{ id, text }], such as a job post, a page of the company's site or its reviews, gathered with the other tools of this folder or tools/browse-public-page).
